verdict.rationale: Medusa's commerce workflows are customized in code you own and deploy from GitHub ([medusa-docs-36], [medusa-docs-1], [medusa-docs-2]), so versioning comes through git, and Cloud offers instant previews on PRs for review ([medusa-docs-11]). Audit logs add some change visibility ([medusa-docs-3]). Rollback is never documented, and none of this is an automation-specific versioning feature; it is inferred from the git-based deployment model. Missing for 10: documented rollback or redeploy of previous versions, automation-specific version history and diffing, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
